original.statement: The NodePool v1beta1 schema adds a status.conditions[] array with standard Kubernetes condition fields (type, status, reason, message, lastTransitionTime, observedGeneration).

decision.reason: The deterministic CRD validators confirm that status.conditions[] appears only in the target release's karpenter.sh/v1beta1 NodePool schema [ev-760ae3491f13] [ev-09bbe26d2f4a]. No user-set field is changed or rejected, so the consequence is 'none'. For that reason the right exposure scope is every environment that uses NodePool v1beta1, which is what the proposed gvk-in-use condition says. It is not broader or narrower than the environments that would see the new status field. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts have no content and there is no canonical exposure shape for an added CRD field.
